name: orbital-revolution
title: Orbital Revolution
description: Satellites revolve a centre point on elliptical paths with independent periods and phases; each body's opacity and scale respond to depth (behind/in front of the centre), faking 3D with pure transforms.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Rail
Density: Airy
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Monospace
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Ambient Loop: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
